blocks.html: 38ft Flybridge – Private Fishing Charter in San José del Cabo

The 38ft Flybridge offers a spacious private fishing experience for groups of up to eight guests, departing exclusively from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo.

Designed for anglers and families seeking extra space and comfort, this 38-foot sportfishing boat features an elevated flybridge, a sheltered cabin, comfortable seating, and a dedicated fishing area. Its layout allows guests to enjoy the fishing action while having room to relax throughout the trip.

Explore the rich fishing waters of the Sea of Cortez, including areas around Gordo Banks and Iman Bank when weather and sea conditions permit. Depending on the season, fishing opportunities may include yellowfin tuna, dorado (mahi-mahi), wahoo, and marlin.

Whether you're planning an offshore fishing adventure with friends or a private family charter, the 38ft Flybridge combines fishing opportunities with the comfort of a larger vessel.

Fishing equipment, bottled water, and soft drinks are included. Fishing licenses, bait, meals, transportation, and other optional services should be confirmed before booking.

Private fishing charter for 1–8 guests. Contact Exotic Fish Cabo for current pricing and availability.
